annotations.title: One finding, with its evidence strength explained

description: Explains one finding by its finding id: the claim, its evidence strength and what that level means, the verbatim quote, the study design and the paper, and evidence_strength_reasons, each rule that set the level in order, and what the assessment does not weigh. The finding id is 26 characters, from the id field of a find_evidence or get_findings finding, or the last part of its permalink (/e/{id}). Use it to answer why the evidence behind a finding is as strong as it is, from evidence_strength_reasons and never by guessing. To find findings, use find_evidence or get_findings; this tool takes no name. A head-to-head comparison id returns a sentence naming the page that shows the comparison, not a finding.

finding_id.description: A 26-character finding id: the id of a finding from find_evidence or get_findings, or the last part of its permalink.
